---
Test
---
!3 Check !-StringTester-!

|script         |!-SlimProxy.Process-!                                                 |
|set working dir|${PROJECT_ROOT}                                                       |
|ensure         |run|!-cmd.exe /c echo SlimForDelphi is great! SlimForDelphi is fast!-!|
|$OUTPUT=       |last output                                                           |

|script|!-SlimProxy.StringTester-!|$OUTPUT                                           |
|ensure|contains                  |!-SlimForDelphi is great! SlimForDelphi is fast!-!|
|check |contains count            |!-SlimForDelphi-!                |2               |
|ensure|matches                   |fast!$                                            |
|check |match count               |!-SlimForDelphi-!                |2               |
|check |match count               |\b[a-z]{4,5}\b                   |2               |

|script|!-SlimProxy.StringTester-!|Hallo Welt|
|check |text                      |Hallo Welt|
|ensure|contains                  |Welt      |
|reject|contains                  |Slim      |
|check |contains count            |l    |3   |
